evidence_slice: Haringey Council's Cabinet decision of 10 February 2026 states that the Station Road sites form part of the 'Wood Green Central' site allocation (WG SA01) within the Haringey Local Plan Regulation 18 draft, consulted on in November and December 2025, for mixed-use redevelopment including new homes, town-centre and employment floorspace, community and cultural uses, public realm and a new green public square.

field_evidence.allocation_status: forms part of the Haringey Local Plan Regulation 18 draft
